name: Journal of Qualitative Inquiry (Korea) profile
description: Optional profile based on the Korean Association for Qualitative Inquiry rules checked on 2026-10-08.

legal_scope.representation: Independent paraphrase of factual submission requirements with a link to the official source.
legal_scope.redistribution_rule: Do not add JQI.hwp, JQI.doc, journal logos, or copied sample manuscripts without an explicit redistribution license from the rights holder.
legal_scope.third_party_notice: See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The MIT license covers this toolkit, not third-party journal materials.

official_requirements.review_anonymity: Do not include author names or affiliations in the review manuscript.
official_requirements.template_note: Obtain the current JQI.hwp or JQI.doc directly from the society; it is not bundled here.
official_requirements.fallback_citation_style: APA 6th edition, as stated by the 2026 official rules

collection_gate.note: These score thresholds are workflow safeguards supplied by this toolkit, not official journal acceptance criteria.
